newsitem.title: USA: Galoob gets $200 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Galoob gets $200 mln credit facility.

text.p: Galoob Toys Inc said Friday it signed an initial commitment letter for a $200 million credit facility with BT Commercial Corp, a unit of Bankers Trust New York Corp.
The commitment is subject to certain conditions, and it is expected that an agreement can be completed within 60 days.

During 1996, the company exchanged preferred stock and convertible debt for common stock during the first quarter and issued 2.4 million shares for $62.7 million in a secondary offering completed in November.
Galoob designs, develops, markets and sells high quality toys worldwide.
